info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Currency Exchange Rate Retrieval API
info.description: The Currency Exchange Rate Retrieval API enables users to obtain real-time exchange rates for various currencies. This endpoint is designed primarily for financial applications, travel agencies, and businesses that need up-to-date currency information for transactions or reporting. By specifying a currency parameter, consumers can access the latest exchange values, facilitating informed decision-making and enhancing customer service. Ideal for developers looking to integrate live currency data into their applications, this API makes currency conversion seamless.

get.description: This endpoint allows developers to fetch the details of a specific currency exchange resource using its unique identifier. It provides comprehensive information necessary for integrating currency exchange functionalities into applications.

requestBody.description: Request body for currency exchange service. This request allows clients to retrieve currency exchange information based on specified parameters.

200.description: The request was successful and the response contains the requested currency exchange information.

GetCurrencyExchangeByIdRequest.description: This schema represents a request body in string format for the currency exchange service operations.

serviceRequestId.description: Unique identifier for the service request.

productCode.description: Code representing the product related to the currency exchange.

amount.description: Details regarding the amount involved in the currency exchange transaction.

requestedDate.description: Date when the currency exchange request was made.

sourceCurrency.description: Currency code of the original currency being exchanged.

targetCurrency.description: Currency code of the currency being received in exchange.

quotedRate.description: The rate at which the exchange is quoted.

cashDenominations.description: Array of integer values representing the cash denominations used in the exchange.
